f: one trained to treat the illnesses of the bones and joints in a hospital or infirmary
one elected to lead the prayers of a congregation in a synagogue or meeting house

f: extreme fondness for animals

a shallow muddy pool left by the tide on a beach

f: a deep hollow

f: tired and worn
crazy and wild

fail to fit together

f: shaped like a bird’s mouth

smelling of damp hay

f: a small round loaf

a clever con artist

f: impossible to find on a map
lacking any clear meaning
unable to be removed

f: (usually of a lens) curved outward on both sides like a ball
(usually of a monk) newly admitted to a religious order
(usually of a road) meeting another at a sharp angle

f: a sand dune
a lady duellist
a rent collector

f: prick or sting (especially with nettles)

f: easily cooked in hot oil or fat until crisp

f: wrinkled and creased
small and stout
quick to fight

f: pious and devout

f: a person devoted to recording the deeds of heroes (especially in long poems)

f: easily mixed together; blended

a weary, defeated attitude

marked by a rich and juicy flavor from long slow cooking in a covered pot

f: a woman who serves as a nurse to the children of a noble family
a woman who sings the leading role in an Italian comic opera
a woman who keeps an inn or tavern on a busy road

f: a thin slice of fish
a small cup or measure
a loose woollen headscarf

f: spicy and full of pepper
fussy about food choices
bright and colorful like paint

f: fiercely cruel
lively and spirited
easily pierced

a drug that builds muscle when injected into the body

a ripe fruit
a formal summons

damp with dew at dawn
harmful to living things
r: nocti- + lucent
